utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Just let me know the first fix, Vik, and I’ll bring the right tools over.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and we need the most help sorting tools and greeting folks at check-in.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: The leaky sink and front door hinge are the most urgent so far. I’ve got a rough count on supplies—just tell me what you need next, and I’ll check what we’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again, just so I make sure I have everything right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll check the flyer and send you the exact list. We’re just trying to fill the gaps Pia flagged.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What are you short on most for the repair drive right now?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly I’m short on the location details right now — I’ll send over the ones I have for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the nails, tarps, tape, and working tools — send me the locations when you have them, and I’ll keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Opal — I’ll send over any locations I remember. If I spot more supplies for the repair drive, I’ll pass those along too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and we could really use help sorting tools or greeting folks at check-in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, perfect — I’ll spread the word that sorting tools and check-in help are the big needs for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll send over a clear list of the locations and priorities next, so we can keep the repair drive organized.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be great — please put the leaky sink and front door hinge first. I’m still figuring out the rest of the list for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, right?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, that’s right — Sunday at the community center. I’m still gathering the rest of the supplies, and the leaky sink and front door hinge are the most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you check the nails and tape first, Faye? I’m trying to keep the list tight so we don’t miss the basics.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes — those are the first two items, and I’ll resend the repair drive details so everyone has the latest info.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll send you the latest repair drive details and locations right away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — send the latest details and locations when you can, and I’ll keep the repair drive list straight.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—what part of the repair drive needs the most help right now?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Send me the latest locations and priorities, and I’ll spread the repair drive invite right away.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Noah — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What still needs doing, and what would you like me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I think the most urgent stuff is still the small repair items. If you can bring tape or a sturdy box, that’d be a big help.
